title: Exploring the coherency and predictability between the stocks of artificial intelligence and energy corporations
summary: The paper studies links between artificial intelligence investments and eight energy-focused sectors. It finds significant dependence and connectedness, especially over intermediate and long-term investment horizons, and a relationship that has grown stronger since the COVID-19 pandemic.
keyFindings: AI and energy stocks show significant dependence and connectedness, especially over intermediate and long-term horizons.
The relationship has become stronger since the COVID-19 pandemic.
Directional predictability from AI to energy varies by sector, horizon and market conditions.
methods: Wavelet coherence, Cross-Quantilogram and time-varying parameter VAR (TVP-VAR) estimation.
